description: Default transaction authorization policy: reproduces this repo's original combine_decision logic as data instead of hardcoded control flow. Either the detect layer flagging BLOCK, or any mandate rule failing, rejects the transaction outright. A detect FLAG with a clean mandate requires step-up review. Everything else is approved.

outcome.reason: detect layer flagged this transaction BLOCK
one or more mandate rules were violated
detect layer is unsure and the mandate raised no objection; step-up review required
detect layer clear and all mandate rules passed
